description: For each employer handle (companyToken, up to 20 a call), its record on this board: open_roles, closed_90d (takedowns watched in 90 days, re-lists excluded), superseded_90d (re-lists, a floor), two medians from the employer's stated dates (lower bounds), tracking_days and feed_total. A takedown is not a hire — a filled role, a cancelled one and a withdrawn one look identical from here — and it is a record of one BOARD, never summed across an employer's boards, never a headcount. A board with no closure observed answers record:'unknown' with its reason, never a verdict about the employer: on a board bigger than one visit can read, no closure is observable to us until we complete a provable full pass and then watch a role go after it. Every row carries its basis. Every row also carries layoff_filing, the newest US state WARN notice or SEC 8-K Item 2.05 disclosure matched to the employer by a curated alias or an exact multi-token name, printed as a filing (filer verbatim, dates with their bases, count, state or form, link), read hourly from SEC EDGAR and nightly from state notices, null when none qualifies within 90 days, and no part of any verdict; layoff_basis says what it is and is not. Pair with employer_growth for the other half of what the site calls "Actively hiring".

companyTokens.description: companyToken values from job cards or search_jobs (a vendor tenant, e.g. 'acme' or 'gici~wd5~Careers'). Up to 20; more is refused with the count named.
